GOOD QUESTIONS

A few things
worth knowing.

Still have something on your mind?

Let’s talk
How does payment work?+

A 50% deposit is required upfront. The remaining 50% is payable before your website launches. The Landing Page package is R2,000 once-off and the Full Website package is R5,000 once-off.

Is hosting and management included?+

The first year is included in the once-off development price. After that, optional hosting and management costs R1,000 per year, including hosting, basic maintenance, and 12 minor website updates annually. Unused updates do not roll over.

What counts as a minor update?+

Text changes, image replacements, pricing updates, and similar small adjustments. Additional pages, major redesigns, and more substantial changes are quoted separately based on your requirements.

Can I manage the website myself?+

Yes. You may take ownership and manage your website independently without subscribing to our ongoing hosting and management service.

What counts as a revision round?+

A revision round is one consolidated set of changes. Both packages include 12 revision rounds per year after the final site is approved. We’ll agree on the scope of your updates together.

Can people contact or book with me through the site?+

Yes. Your contact or booking button can link to WhatsApp, email, or an external booking platform, depending on how you prefer to hear from customers.

Do I need to know anything about websites?+

No. Book a call, tell us about your business, and we’ll guide the design and build. You’ll have a chance to review the website before it goes live.

How long will it take?+

We’ll agree on a realistic timeline after learning about your business, page requirements, and the content available. Your project starts with a clear scope and next steps.

What if I already have a website?+

Send us the link. We can discuss what’s working, what needs to change, and whether a landing page or a full website is the better fit.
